column1: # ADR 0007 D3: the optional per-component `model` binding. Presence
# selects the expected key list, so absence stays legal; a non-symbol
# model fails with its own scenario code, while a duplicated or
# misplaced model key never reaches the scenario layer because the
# canonical decoder rejects the record first (ADR 0002 codes).
# ADR 0005 canonical-profile/m1-large boundary fixtures. scenario/v1 names
# that profile statically; each frame below is a genuine scenario/v1 frame
# whose boundary payload lives in one property's opaque spec value.
# Two further kinds are used below:
#   L|name|relative-frame-path                valid, checked exactly as V,
# ADR 0005 verification 3: the same accepted m1-large frames presented to
# the plain ADR 0002 m0 canonical entry point still reject, fail-closed,
